editorial:
Imagine you are just trying to land a big acting role by filming a demo tape at home with your partner. That is exactly where you start in this creepy ride. You follow a couple who are so focused on playing the parts of people linked to Charles Manson that they do not notice the lines between the script and real life starting to blur. The vibe is super tense and makes you feel like someone is always watching from the shadows. It starts out as a simple story about ambition but quickly turns into a nightmare where the characters are trapped in a game they cannot stop.

What really works here is how the tension builds up slowly until it just explodes. The acting feels natural, and the twists will actually catch you off guard. While some parts move a bit slow in the middle, the scary payoff is totally worth it. If you love movies that mess with your head, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: You find out that the audition was actually a trap set by a modern cult. The couple was not just acting; they were being groomed to join a sinister group. In the final scenes, the lead characters realize they have been manipulated into performing a ritual. The twist is that the occult leader used the movie script to brainwash them. It ends with the realization that they are now stuck in the cult's grip with no way out.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and stories about secret societies.
